threshold.value: With respect to Party A and any Valuation Date, zero if a Collateral Event has occurred and has been continuing (x) for at least 30 days or (y) since this Annex was executed; otherwise, infinity. With respect to Party B and any Valuation Date, infinity.
threshold.evidence_quote:
"THRESHOLD" means, with respect to Party A and any Valuation
                    Date, zero if a Collateral Event has occurred and has been
                    continuing (x) for at least 30 days or (y) since this Annex
                    was executed; otherwise, infinity.

                    "THRESHOLD" means, with respect to Party B and any Valuation
                    Date, infinity.

minimum_transfer_amount.value: USD 100,000 with respect to Party A and Party B; provided, however, that if the aggregate Class Certificate Balance of the Certificates rated by S&P ceases to be more than USD 50,000,000, the "Minimum Transfer Amount" shall be USD 50,000.
minimum_transfer_amount.evidence_quote:
"MINIMUM TRANSFER AMOUNT" means USD 100,000 with respect to
                    Party A and Party B; provided, however, that if the
                    aggregate Class Certificate Balance of the Certificates
                    rated by S&P ceases to be more than USD 50,000,000, the
                    "Minimum Transfer Amount" shall be USD 50,000.

rounding.value: The Delivery Amount will be rounded up to the nearest integral multiple of USD 10,000. The Return Amount will be rounded down to the nearest integral multiple of USD 1,000.
rounding.evidence_quote:
ROUNDING: The Delivery Amount will be rounded up to the
                    nearest integral multiple of USD 10,000. The Return Amount
                    will be rounded down to the nearest integral multiple of USD
                    1,000.
